create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
save_and_load_graph: save a gtn Graph to disk with savetxt or save and load it back with loadtxt or load
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar gtn Graph from a single weight value using gtn.scalar_graph
run_backward_on_graph_operations: run gtn.backward on the result of gtn.add or gtn.subtract to compute gradients on input graphs
concatenate_and_remove_graphs_in_paralle: concatenate a list of gtn Graphs with gtn.concat or remove epsilon arcs with gtn.remove
